Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane.** `domain:cli`. The seam is `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` (`ctx.title`, #11293; read at `:178`–`:235` on `origin/main` `7a8733f1c7`).
